zh: 优化首页「发现应用」菜单交互，点击启动任意工具或底部功能后自动收起下拉面板。
增强搜索框键盘操作，在应用搜索输入框按下回车键即可直接打开首项匹配工具并收起菜单。
统一工具内嵌框架与独立导航事件流，工具在主区就绪时自动清理顶层悬浮菜单。
修复二级菜单与发现面板在跨模块跳转时的残留问题，提升菜单启闭流畅度与使用习惯一致性。
en: Refined Discover Apps menu interaction, automatically closing the dropdown panel upon clicking any tool or action.
Enhanced search input keyboard accessibility, allowing Enter key to launch the top matching tool and dismiss the menu.
Unified tool frame embedding and standalone navigation event dispatch to clean up active popovers when tools open.
Resolved floating menu residue across discovery and secondary flyouts for smoother, predictable navigation.
